Tip_Convert: Convert an old (Python) flow from a project folder to the new format
Tip_AiFlow: Generate a flow from a description
Tip_Explain: Have the AI explain the current flow
Tip_Suggest: Have the AI suggest the next node after the selected one
Tip_Step: One node further, then pause again
Tip_Search: Find a node / jump to it (Ctrl+F)
Tip_Align: Snap all nodes to the grid
Tip_NodeSuggest: Toggle AI suggestion for the next node
Set_Channel: System browser (channel) — empty = default/bundled; brave requires browser type chromium
Set_DriverPath: Playwright driver path (only if not found automatically)
Set_DriverHelp1: Driver/browsers won't download automatically? Guide for manual/offline installation:
Set_DriverHelp2: Behind a proxy: set the proxy in the “Network” tab (also applies to the download host).
Set_SessionReuse: Reuse session (cookies/login) — save it with the “Save session” node
Set_SessionFile: Session file (empty = session.json in the project folder)
Set_ProxyIntro: Proxy — applies to the browser and to AI requests.
Set_ProxyServer: Proxy server (empty = no proxy / system default)
Set_AiIntro: Generate a flow from a description (toolbar: 🤖 AI flow).
Set_DetectLocalAiTip: Checks for locally running LLM servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, Jan)
Set_BaseUrl: Base URL (optional, e.g. local Ollama instance)
Set_SendHints: Send hints / known fixes to the AI
Set_Hints: Known issues & fixes (one per line, keep them short — the AI receives them with every request)
Set_PluginsIntro: Custom nodes as a DLL in the plugins folder. Changes (enabled/disabled) take effect after a restart.
Set_NoPlugins: No plugins found. Put a DLL into one of the folders listed below and restart.
Set_PluginToggleTip: Enabled (checked) / disabled — takes effect after a restart
Vault_HintUnlock: Enter the master password to unlock this flow's vault.
Vault_HintCreate: No vault in this flow yet — set a master password to create one.
Search_Placeholder: Type a name or type…  (Enter = jump, Esc = close)
Chat_InputPlaceholder: Ask a question or describe a flow…  (Enter = send, Shift+Enter = new line)
Chat_LoadLatestTip: Load the flow most recently suggested by the AI into the editor
Chat_LoadFlowTip: Load this flow into the editor
Chat_RememberTip: Save this answer (shortened) as an AI hint
Af_Intro: Describe what the flow should do. The AI generates a flow from it, which is validated before loading.
Af_PromptPlaceholder: e.g.: Open https://example.com, click the login button, enter user and password from the payload, and save the page heading to a file.
Af_NotConfigured: No AI connection configured. Please set an API key in the settings (or choose Ollama as the provider).
Ns_Intro: Suggestion for the next node after the selected node:
Ns_NotConfigured: No AI connection configured. Please set an API key in the settings (“AI” tab) or choose Ollama as the provider.
